reviews.title: BEST BOARD EVER ....  NOT,  BUT
reviews.comment: This is a great board. I have built at least 10-15 of these. When combined with a ryzen5 or 7 that have onboard graphics, it plays 90 % of the games out there with no add on graphics card. They are solid, easily configed, I have had zero issues.  PRICE IS HARD TO BEAT
reviews.author: Ron Oetzel

reviews.title: A huge relief
reviews.comment: I bought this motherboard to replace a brand new MSI Tomahawk MB which arrived broken. This Gigabyte board, on the other hand was a breeze to install and configure. Its exactly what I needed and I love it.
reviews.author: Jordan Roberts
